cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The collapsed cake was foreshadowed by that first wobble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I allowed the audience to discover its significance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.

mechanism: Copy a baker's removal of a support as presentation, then claim the resulting cake collapse fulfilled earlier wobble details deliberately planted.
confusable: Not D209 learning from failure or D234 predicting surprises: A must specifically claim the failure itself was a planned turn, using previously spoken physical clues.
comparison: Cake presentation and serving improvisation differ from tent collapse and a planned night under stars.
seedUse: Retains initial wobble/collapsed cake as apparent foreshadowing; adds copied removal of structural support.
